entities.name: PMID:25422135
observations: Carneiro et al. examined effects of ovariectomy on renal dysfunction in female ApoE-deficient and C57 control mice; renal outcomes were assessed two months after surgery.

entities.name: OVX reduces ApoE renal function
observations: In female ApoE-deficient mice, sham creatinine clearance was 140±26 μL/min and was similar to sham C57 controls (171±17); ovariectomy reduced clearance to 61±10 μL/min (~56% decrease, p<0.05) after two months.
Ovariectomy also reduced clearance in C57 controls by about 35%; findings support an endogenous ovarian-hormone protective effect but do not isolate estrogen from other ovarian hormones.
